narrative.intro: UT-Battelle obligated $2.8B in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. UT-Battelle won 1 award this fiscal year, giving an average award size of $2.8B. UT-Battelle obligations are up 3.0% year over year. FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date and therefore partial. FY21 obligations were $2.3B, FY22 obligations were $2.5B, FY23 obligations were $2.7B, FY24 obligations were $2.5B, and FY25 obligations were $2.7B, showing that UT-Battelle has remained in a narrow band of roughly $2.3B to $2.8B across the last six fiscal years. UT-Battelle’s FY2026 to date total sits at the top of that range, continuing the program-level scale evident since FY21. UT-Battelle’s award count and average award size indicate concentration in a single large award this fiscal year. UT-Battelle’s available figures are contract obligations except where tables explicitly report total contract values, and current-year totals are partial.

sections.body: UT-Battelle recorded 1 award in FY2026 to date, with an average award size of $2.8B. UT-Battelle’s single-award pattern this year means most obligations are concentrated in that award. sections.heading: How has UT-Battelle’s annual obligation level trended?
